Option 002 originally closed at 16:00 UTC on 18 November 2026 (Record F3). An authorized amendment (Record P8) extends option 002 only to 16:00 UTC on 20 November 2026. The election is at 15:00 UTC on 19 November 2026, which falls within the extended deadline. Client authorization is present and all other eligibility checks passed (F3). So the election can be transmitted.
